name: headroom
description: Keeps the main session's context small by delegating token-heavy work to three worker roles (scout, implementer, reviewer), with a spawn check, nudges, and optional blocks.

hard_blocks.title: Block delegable work in the main session
hard_blocks.description: Refuse test/build/lint/type-check runs and repo-wide searches in the main session; lift with /headroom:inline.

block_patterns.title: Extra block patterns
block_patterns.description: Extra extended regex (ERE) matched against Bash commands, added to the built-in list.

read_max_bytes.title: Largest file the main session may Read whole
read_max_bytes.description: Refuse a Read of a file at or over this many bytes (unless it sets limit to 400 or fewer lines, or is an image or pdf); on by default. 0 turns the check off.
